description: A family of public online map portals showing mining licences from national mining cadastres run on the Landfolio software. The Spatial Dimension portals page lists public portals for Angola, Cameroon, the Dominican Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Guinea, Liberia, Malawi, Mauritania, Mozambique, Senegal, South Sudan, Togo and Zambia, and one for Crown land in Victoria, Australia; the DRC portal of the Cadastre Minier (CAMI) at drclicences.cami.cd shows mining licences on a map. IPIS published an earlier map of mining concessions in the DRC built on official CAMI data as of 27 July 2010. The portals are free to view in a browser; downloads and terms differ by country. Coverage is the listed countries. Caveats: the licence, update practice and exportable fields are set by each agency and are not stated on the pages read. For simulation it gives licence polygons and holders for mapping where mines will need power, water, roads and rail, and for exposure of mining areas to hazards. A related catalogue record is the WRI mining concessions dataset.
